## Why This Is Asked
Assess end-to-end pipeline design in a VPC-restricted, privacy-conscious setting with repeatable training, validation, and deployment workflows.

## Key Concepts
- **SageMaker Pipelines**: Orchestrates the complete ML workflow from data preparation through deployment
- **SageMaker Model Registry**: Manages model versioning with stage-based approvals (Pending → Approved → Production)
- **Two-stage Canary Deployments**: Gradually shift traffic with shadow testing to validate production behavior before full cutover
- **Model Monitor**: Continuously detects data and concept drift to maintain model quality

```python
capture_config = DataCaptureConfig(
    enable_capture=True,
    sampling_percentage=100,
    capture_options=["REQUEST", "RESPONSE"],
    csv_content_types=["text/csv"],
    json_content_types=["application/json"]
)

    role=monitoring_role,
    instance_count=1,
    instance_type='ml.m5.xlarge',
    volume_size_in_gb=20,
    max_runtime_in_seconds=1800
)

monitor.create_monitoring_schedule(
    endpoint_input=endpoint_name,
    output_s3_uri=monitoring_output_path,
    schedule_cron_expression=cron_expression,
    record_preprocessor_script=preprocessor_script,
    post_processor_script=post_processor_script,
    monitor_schedule_name=monitor_schedule_name
)
```
